findingDetails.title: One-lineage --executors branch pins an ambiguous maxIterations binding
findingDetails.scopeProof: all five carriers are listed review-scope files
findingDetails.case: A one-entry --executors matrix carrying iterations:4 alongside --max-iterations 10 can be bound to config.executor.iterations=4 or to top-level maxIterations=4; both readings match the instruction text.

findingDetails.title: --executors option row still describes the value as a whole fan-out matrix
findingDetails.scopeProof: both command pages are listed review-scope files
findingDetails.case: A caller supplies a one-entry --executors with --concurrency 3 expecting fan-out; the policy writes config.executor and leaves config.fanout unset, silently dropping concurrency and fan-out stop-policy handling.

findingDetails.title: The opt-in flag has no public documentation
findingDetails.scopeProof: runner, both command pages and the runbook are declared scope files
findingDetails.case: An operator refused by the runner is told to leave the runner; if they must stay, the only in-repo discovery path for the opt-in is one bare flag in a runbook command with no sentence explaining when to add it.

findingDetails.title: The value form of the opt-in is refused and the message hides the opt-in
findingDetails.scopeProof: guard and parser are the child 003 change
findingDetails.case: --allow-single-lineage followed by a non-flag token sets the string value and args.allowSingleLineage !== true refuses a caller who opted in, with a message that points away from the opt-in.

findingDetails.title: The installed plan_clarity criteria contradicts the packet own CHK-012
findingDetails.scopeProof: asset and child 006 packet docs are both in scope
findingDetails.case: A closeout run walks CHK-012 against the shipped asset, finds the criteria key the row forbids, and cannot record a clean closeout; nothing executes CHK-012 at runtime.

findingDetails.title: An eighth generated contract moved with no owning phase
findingDetails.scopeProof: file is a listed review-scope file; scope tables live in 002/spec.md
findingDetails.case: A reviewer reconciling the working tree against the frozen Files to Change tables finds an artifact with no owning phase and must widen child 002 or record the refresh separately.
